shortDescription: VANCOUVER, BC, Nov. 17, 2026 /CNW/ -- Revolve Renewable Power Corp. (CSE:REVV) (OTCQB: REVVF) ("Revolve" or the "Company"), a North American owner, operator and developer of renewable energy projects, today reminds its shareholders (the "Shareholders") of the upcoming special meeting of shareholder…

children: Independent proxy advisory firm ISS recommends that shareholders vote FOR the Arrangement Resolution, consistent with the recommendation of the Board of Directors.

Registered shareholders holding at least 10,000 Shares who wish to exchange their Shares into equity of the Purchaser must deposit a valid election and a duly executed Joinder Agreement, by 5:00 p.m. (Vancouver time) on November 25, 2026. Shareholders who do not take such action will receive $0.23 in cash per Share.

At the request of staff of the Ontario Securities Commission, completion of the Arrangement will also require approval by a majority of the votes cast, excluding the votes of Shareholders who elect to receive the Unit Consideration.
VANCOUVER, BC, Nov. 17, 2026 /CNW/ --
Revolve Renewable Power Corp.
) (OTCQB: REVVF) ("
Revolve
" or the "
Company
"), a North American owner, operator and developer of renewable energy projects, today reminds its shareholders (the "
Shareholders
") of the upcoming special meeting of shareholders to be held on November 24, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. (Vancouver time) at 700 W Georgia Street, Suite 2200, Vancouver, BC V7Y 1K8 (the "
Meeting
") to consider the previously announced statutory plan of arrangement (the "
Arrangement
") under the
Business Corporations Act
(British Columbia) involving the Company and Whitfield Power Solutions, LLC (the "
Purchaser
"), an affiliate of Callaway Capital Management, LLC, and of the steps Shareholders must take if they wish to elect to exchange their common shares of the Company (the "
Shares
") into equity of the Purchaser.
Under the Arrangement, Shareholders may elect to receive, for their Shares, either (i) cash consideration of $0.23 per Share (the "
Cash Consideration
") or (ii) subject to the terms and conditions of the Arrangement, one Class B unit representing a membership interest in the Purchaser (a "
Purchaser Class B Unit
") for each 10,000 Shares (the "
Unit Consideration
" and such election to receive Purchaser Class B Units, the "
Equity Option
"). The Cash Consideration represents a premium of 31.4% to the closing price of the Shares on the Canadian Securities Exchange (the "
CSE

") on September 14, 2026, the last trading day prior to the announcement of the Arrangement, and a premium of 32.3% based on the 20-day volume weighted average trading price of the Shares on the CSE as of that date. Full details of the Arrangement are set out in the Company's management information circular dated September 28, 2026 (the "
Circular
"), which is available under the Company's profile on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca.
Independent Proxy Advisor Recommends Shareholders Vote FOR the Arrangement
The Company is pleased to announce that Institutional Shareholder Services Inc. ("
ISS
"), an independent proxy advisory firm, has recommended that Shareholders vote
FOR
the special resolution approving the Arrangement (the "
Arrangement Resolution
The recommendation of ISS is consistent with the recommendation of the board of directors of the Company (the "
Board
"). Following the unanimous recommendation of a special committee of the Board comprised entirely of independent directors (the "
Special Committee

"), and after receiving advice from the Company's legal counsel and financial advisor, the Board (with one director having recused himself due to a conflict of interest) unanimously determined that the Arrangement is in the best interests of the Company and that the consideration to be received by Shareholders under the Arrangement is fair, from a financial point of view, to Shareholders. The Board recommends that Shareholders vote FOR the Arrangement Resolution.
Completion of the Arrangement and Additional Shareholder Approval

At the request of staff of the Ontario Securities Commission, in addition to the shareholder approvals described in the Circular, completion of the Arrangement will be conditional upon approval of the Arrangement Resolution by a simple majority of the votes cast at the Meeting, excluding the votes attached to Shares held by Shareholders who elect to receive the Unit Consideration. The result of this additional approval will be determined following the Election Deadline (as defined below) and announced by news release. Completion of the Arrangement also remains subject to receipt of the final order of the Supreme Court of British Columbia approving the Arrangement (the "
Final Order

") and the satisfaction or waiver of other customary conditions, and is currently expected to occur on or about November 30, 2026. Following completion, the Shares are expected to be delisted from the CSE and the OTCQB and the Company is expected to apply to cease to be a reporting issuer.
Key Dates
November 20, 2026, 9:00 a.m. (Vancouver time)
: Proxy voting deadline for the Meeting.
Submitting a proxy does not constitute an election to receive the Unit Consideration.
November 24, 2026, 9:00 a.m. (Vancouver time)
: Special Meeting of Shareholders.
November 25, 2026, 9:45 a.m. (Vancouver time)
: Anticipated hearing of the application for the Final Order.
November 25, 2026, 5:00 p.m. (Vancouver time)
: Current and expected deadline (the "
Election Deadline
") to elect the Unit Consideration and deposit a duly executed joinder agreement (the "
Joinder Agreement

") (see further details below). Non-registered Shareholders must first become registered Shareholders in order to make an election. Any change to the anticipated effective date and election deadline will be announced by news release.
On or about November 30, 2026
: Anticipated completion of the Arrangement, subject to Shareholder approval and receipt of the Final Order and the satisfaction or waiver of the remaining conditions.
How to Elect the Cash Option
No action required. If you do nothing, you will automatically receive the Cash Consideration of $0.23 per Share.
The Equity Option – Summary
What is the Equity Option?

Instead of receiving the Cash Consideration, eligible Shareholders may elect to exchange their Shares for Purchaser Class B Units, being one Purchaser Class B Unit for each 10,000 Shares. The Equity Option provides Shareholders with the opportunity to retain an equity investment in the Purchaser following completion of the Arrangement and to participate in any potential future growth and value appreciation of the business. The Purchaser is a private company. The Purchaser Class B Units will not be listed on any stock exchange and there is no established trading market for them. The Purchaser Class B Units will be subject to the transfer restrictions and other terms of the amended and restated limited liability company agreement of the Purchaser (the "
LLC Agreement
"), a summary of which is included in the Circular.
The exchange of Shares for Purchaser Class B Units will generally be a taxable disposition for Canadian federal income tax purposes. See "
Certain Canadian Federal Income Tax Considerations

" in the Circular). The Purchaser Class B Units are not expected to be qualified investments for registered retirement savings plans, tax-free savings accounts or other registered plans, and adverse tax consequences should be expected if they are held in such a plan. See "
Certain Canadian Federal Income Tax Considerations — Non-Eligibility for Investment
" in the Circular.
How was the exchange ratio determined?

The exchange ratio of one Purchaser Class B Unit for every 10,000 Shares was proposed by the Purchaser during negotiations with the Special Committee. The Special Committee met with a representative of the Purchaser to discuss the Purchaser's capital structure, future plans and prospects, operational matters and the risks involved with holding equity securities in the Purchaser, and engaged in lengthy negotiations with the Purchaser regarding the terms of the Equity Option, including the exchange ratio. As a condition of agreeing to the exchange ratio, the Special Committee required that each Shareholder who elects to receive the Unit Consideration have the right to sell their Purchaser Class B Units back to the Purchaser at a price roughly equivalent to the Cash Consideration that Shareholders could otherwise have received under the Arrangement. In response, the Purchaser agreed to extend the period of the holders' right, under the LLC Agreement, to require the Purchaser to purchase their Purchaser Class B Units at a fixed price of US$1,650.00 per Purchaser Class B Unit (the "
Put Right

"), exercisable during the 18 months following issuance of the Purchaser Class B Units. The Put Right is subject to important limitations, including possible deferral of payment and the credit risk of the Purchaser, as described in Schedule G to the Circular. Following its review, the Special Committee determined that the terms of the Equity Option, taken as a whole, were reasonable and that providing the Equity Option to Shareholders was in the best interests of the Company. In making its recommendation, the Special Committee also noted that the election is entirely voluntary and that the Circular includes full, true and plain disclosure of all material facts regarding the Purchaser, including, among other things, its audited financial statements and the risks relating to holding equity securities of the Purchaser, so that Shareholders can make an informed decision whether to elect the Unit Consideration in lieu of the Cash Consideration.
Who is eligible?

Only a Shareholder who is the registered owner of at least 10,000 Shares immediately prior to the effective time of the Arrangement may elect the Unit Consideration. Shareholders who hold their Shares through a broker or other intermediary (including CDS & Co.) cannot make the election unless they first become registered Shareholders (see "How to Elect the Equity Option" below). No fractional Purchaser Class B Units will be issued; any fractional entitlement will be rounded down and paid in cash in accordance with the Arrangement.
How to Elect the Equity Option:
If you wish to elect the Equity Option, both of the following steps must be completed before the Election Deadline:
Step 1 — Make the election.
Deposit a duly completed letter of transmittal and election form (the "
Letter of Transmittal and Election Form
") electing the Unit Consideration with Computershare Investor Services Inc. (the "
Depositary
"). Once deposited, the Letter of Transmittal and Election Form is irrevocable.
Step 2 — Deliver the Joinder Agreement.

Deliver a duly executed Joinder Agreement, pursuant to which you agree to become a party to and be bound by the LLC Agreement, to the Company, c/o Miller Thomson LLP, Scotia Plaza, 40 King Street West, Suite 6600, Toronto, Ontario M5H 3S1, Attention: Legal Counsel to Revolve Renewable Power Corp.

Only registered Shareholders can elect the Unit Consideration. Shareholders who hold through a broker must first register their Shares in their own name and should contact their broker immediately. Registered Shareholders must deposit both the Letter of Transmittal and Election Form (with the Depositary) and the Joinder Agreement (with the Company c/o Miller Thomson LLP) by 5:00 p.m. (Vancouver time) on November 25, 2026. If you do nothing, you will automatically receive the Cash Consideration of $0.23 per Share.
See "
Procedure for Elections by Electing Shareholders
" in the Circular.
Shareholders should carefully review the Circular, and consult their own financial, legal and tax advisors, before deciding whether to elect the Equity Option.

Further information regarding the Arrangement, the Equity Option, the Purchaser Class B Units and the tax consequences of the Arrangement is set out in the Circular, which is available under the Company's profile on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca and on the Company's website.
About Revolve

Revolve was formed in 2012 to capitalize on the growing global demand for renewable power. Revolve develops utility-scale wind, solar, hydro and battery storage projects in the U.S,, Canada and Mexico. Revolve also installs and operates sub 20 megawatt ("
MW
") "behind the meter" distributed generation (or "
DG
") assets. Revolve's portfolio includes the following:
Operating Assets: 36.2 MW (net) of operating assets under long term power purchase agreements across the U.S., Canada and Mexico covering wind, solar, battery storage and hydro generation;

Development: a diverse portfolio of utility-scale development projects across the U.S., Canada and Mexico with a combined capacity of over 3,000MWs as well as a 140MW+ distributed generation portfolio that is under development.

Revolve has an accomplished management team with a demonstrated track record of taking projects from "greenfield" through to "ready to build" status and successfully concluding project sales to large operators of utility-scale renewable energy projects. To date, Revolve has developed and sold over 1,550MW of projects.
About Whitfield Power Solutions, LLC
Whitfield Power Solutions, LLC, is an affiliate of Callaway Capital Management, LLC and was established to focus on the development of digital infrastructure projects across North America.
